findings.title: Valid preloaded governed custody drops the repository namespace and refuses present exact bytes
findings.observed: A hermetic CA fixture with valid unmodified adoption and input manifest, exact CRM-307 body at its repository-relative path, and canonical resolved custody with exact path/hash/length returns no unresolvable entries but family_sources_bind reports present=false and bound=false.
findings.cause: The custody preload pushes only sourceId/path/sha256. The recovered binding loop then skips its canonical binding because that sourceId already exists. Native resolution therefore joins the path to the Master Library root rather than the repository root.
findings.impact: Previously resolved canonical custody fails preflight solely because it was already resolved; the stale unresolved custody positive case passes. This prevents a valid governed admission from reliably unblocking its recorded family.
findings.requiredFix: After validating all governed custody assertions and admission, return the canonical recovered binding for each expected governed source, preserving pathRoot=repositoryRoot and byteLength. Preserve refusals for invalid admission, contradictory duplicates and aliases. Add a positive resolved-custody fixture asserting both repositoryRoot and native family_sources_bind.ok=true; test duplicate exact resolved custody as well.

probeSetup.procedure: Copy only body, admission and manifest into a fresh worker /tmp directory, preserving repository-relative paths. Write custody.rows=[{worklistGroupId:'ca-diversion-seal-set',documentSources:[{sourceId:'official-form:SDSC-CRM-307',resolved:true,heldAs:{path:body,sha256:bodySha256,byteLength:211228}}]}]. Invoke familySources(family,tmp) and runAll(tmp,{family}).find(r=>r.id==='family_sources_bind'). Remove only the newly created temporary fixture.
